inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The primary caregiver is in the process of completing annual trainings. 36 of 55 modules have been completed. The 55 modules will be 44 training hours pertaining to the required trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A household member over the age of 14 was present without an active background check. This was corrected when the primary caregiver ran a background check for the household member which now shows pending in CLASS.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: Primary caregiver had 13 of 30 annual training hours available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training: substitute caregiver was missing 2 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not complete a monthly fire drill for the following months:     January   Februrary  April  May
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Annual Training-counted in ratio more than 10 times in a training year: A caregiver did not have annual trainings completed while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Annual Training-counted in ratio more than 10 times in a training year (26 TAC §747.1305(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking: A two-month-old infant was asleep on a bed.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was moved to a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking (26 TAC §747.2305(1))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: A substitute caregiver did not have current First Aid/CPR certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There was no infant feeding instructions for a two-month-old-infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of four children did not have an address listed for their emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A two-month-old infant was asleep on their stomach.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was moved to their back to sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §747.2327)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted a fire drill since May 2021.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when a fire drill was conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a Children's Product Safety Annual Certification.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver completed the Children's Product Safety Annual Certification.

Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation has not documented the carbon monoxide or smoke detector testing since May 2021.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the carbon monoxide and smoke detectors were tested and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not contain a policy on the promotion of physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
